CVE-2026-107493.impact_statement: Application code makes no direct PEM_X509_INFO calls or native OpenSSL calls. System OpenSSL is reached through CPython TLS certificate loading, whose OpenSSL caller passes a NULL stack; OpenSSL states that path is not affected.

CVE-2026-107494.impact_statement: The service has no QUIC client or server stack. The affected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID queue cannot be reached.

CVE-2026-121482.impact_statement: The product does not process CMS or PKCS#7 SignedData and does not enable CRL checking. The attacker-controlled CMS/PKCS#7 verification path described by OpenSSL is absent.

CVE-2026-124709.impact_statement: The service exposes HTTP/1.1 through Uvicorn/h11 and has no QUIC implementation or API path. OpenSSL QUIC server stream handling is not executable in this product.

CVE-2026-35190.impact_statement: The production service does not configure an OpenSSL TLS server or call SSL_CTX_set_cert_flags with SSL_CERT_FLAG_SUITEB_128_LOS, so the affected TLS 1.3 server key-share path is absent.

CVE-2026-84785.impact_statement: The production service has no QUIC implementation or execute path, so OpenSSL QUIC stream reassembly cannot be reached.

CVE-2026-84786.impact_statement: The product does not use OpenSSL DANE APIs or TLSA records, so the affected DANE client validation path is absent.
